thread:
Maria_CS: starting an ops sync for AlderTech dedicated bring-up — want a compact plan we can hand to AM and SRE after tests
Priya_CS: quick context: AlderTech needs predictable latency for chat assist. They asked for a proof-of-capacity before renewing.
Dan_SRE: high-level ask: define quota, run warmup + soak, validate autoscale and fallback behavior, capture cost delta.
Noor_MLE: recommends m-redwood-1.5b-int8 for the baseline (lower cost) and m-redwood-3b-q4f as the quality tier. we'll measure 1k–3k tokens/request variance.
Alex_Sales: renewal sensitivity noted — they set a soft budget cap next quarter. we should capture per-1k-token cost estimates for both configs.
Priya_CS: proposed quota: reserve capacity equivalent to 14k tokens/sec peak. translate to requests assuming average 800 tokens/request -> ~17.5 req/s baseline, but plan for RPS bursts.
Dan_SRE: load tests planned:
- smoke: 10m ramp to 60 rps, verify p50/p95 and 5xx <0.5%
- soak: 90m at steady 45 rps with 3x short bursts to 180 rps (3m each)
- resilience: trigger a mid-soak model failover to smaller variant and observe fallbacks
Snippet for replay:
```
python infra/replay.py --trace aldertech_72h.json --rate 45 --burst 180 --duration 5400
wrk -t6 -c120 -d60s --latency https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate
```
Noor_MLE: track these metrics: token/sec, requests/sec, p50/p95 latency, model-fallback-count, cache-hit-rate, and per-prompt error tags. Add small eval set (15 prompts) pre/post.
Priya_CS: enablement checklist for the handoff call: VPC peering confirmation, org API keys, KMS ACL, runbook link, billing contact.
Maria_CS: actions: 1) Priya confirm keys for shadow replay 2) Dan create ephemeral env and set autoscale policy 3) Noor prepare eval prompts and compare models 4) Alex run budget sensitivity calc.
ci-bot: ephemeral env created -> redwood-stg-alder-2025-02-14, logs shipped to #eng-runtime, temp keys masked.
Dan_SRE: autoscale policy suggestion: min=1, target=65% util, max=6, scale-cooldown=45s, pre-warm=1 slot on heavy bursts. confirm with customer?
Alex_Sales: AlderTech requests min=2 max=8 to guarantee headroom; finance is ok with small overprovision for launch week.
Noor_MLE: cost trade-off note: 3b q4f is ~2.3x token-cost vs 1.5b int8 but should have better QA on their eval set. I'll quantify after smoke.
Priya_CS: scheduling: smoke Fri 09:30 PT, soak Sat 02:00 PT (off-hours), resilience test during soak. Pinged AlderTech for keys and 1-pt slack contact.
Dan_SRE: I'll push the load scripts and dashboards to the onboarding card. will also add alert thresholds: sustained p95 >1200ms, or error-rate >1% triggers rollback.
Maria_CS: please add renewal risk note in the card: customer signaled budget cap, include cost delta and recommended fallback plan for QBR.
Noor_MLE: will run pre/post eval and post a short summary on quality delta (<string-metrics>) after tests.
ci-bot: scheduled ephemeral-env teardown -> 2025-02-15T10:00:00Z
Priya_CS: thanks all — I'll also capture customer feedback items during the enablement call and attach to the onboarding doc. reopening thread after smoke results. :white_check_mark:
